axes.concept: Open consultation folds: dense working information, every cumulative tool list stays visible; selecting means highlighting for comparison only.
axes.layout: One ruled paper; four horizontal plan blocks with a name/price column and adjacent tool lists. Desktop 192px index, tablet index above the paper in two columns, phone stacked plan blocks.
axes.navigation: Existing Pictures/Sempertex shell; neutral comparison/selection route rule, in-page four-plan index, sign-in and account-menu /planes entry points, explicit return to comparison and origin.
axes.typography: Existing embedded Geist Sans and Geist Mono; 24px page title and prices, 20px plan names, 14px tools, 12px availability, tabular price figures.
axes.density: Compact 12px tool spacing and 24px ruled plan separation inside one 28px-padded paper; 20px phone insets; all four plan headings and first tools visible at 1280x1100.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input and Skeleton; native account disclosure, language select and comparison-only radios; custom ruled lists instead of pricing cards or accordions.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures globals.css light/dark tokens and sibling accessible input alias; neutral active navigation, primary only for selected plan and return action. No new palette.
axes.motion: Precise registration: plan rows travel 12px with 45ms offsets, rule grows from .45 to 1; 300ms expressive ease(.23,1,.32,1), 180ms controls. Reduced/still removes travel and repetition; hidden tabs pause CSS effects.
